messages.subject: space-time interaction
parts:
Hi Dear all,

I have some problems in simulating of space-time interaction for lattice data. we know the precision matrix of interaction between spatial effect and time effect is Kronecker product of the structure matrix of spatial effect and time effect respectively. and then we should get inverse of that and produce from multivariate Gaussian. But the result of Kronecker product matrix is singular and we can not get inverse.  What can I do? How can I produce a space-time interaction for lattice data?

Thanks in advance for your help and time.

Leila

messages.author: 66ed4f72a898a51c
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] space-time interaction
parts:
Hi,

You do not need to invert the precision matrix. See algorithm 3.1 in the GMRF book. There is a function to sample from Knorr-Held's four type of interaction models available in INLA. Please see inla.knmodels.sample() if this helps.

best regards,

Elias
